raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "supervision" %}
{% set version = "0.30.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/supervision-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2289c28cde528009a82a9b0582bc5ce76d90b8645c76d0783b6b7abc3fc5c572

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - python
    - pip
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - av >=14.2
    - defusedxml >=0.7.1
    - matplotlib-base >=3.6
    - numpy >=1.21.2
    - pillow >=9.4
    - pydeprecate >=0.9,<0.12
    - pyyaml >=5.3
    - requests >=2.26
    - scipy >=1.10
    - tqdm >=4.62.3


test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - pandas-stubs
  imports:
    - supervision
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://pypi.org/project/supervision/
  summary: Supervision is reusable computer vision tools.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  description: |
    [![Supervision](https://media.roboflow.com/open-source/supervision/rf-supervision-banner.png?updatedAt=1678995927529)](https://supervision.roboflow.com)
